summary: SiteDocument is a C# class used to represent documents associated with a site, primarily storing ID and SiteID fields. It is part of the HSPnet.DataLayer namespace and is likely used for tracking or referencing documents linked to specific sites within the application.
purpose: Represents a document related to a site, providing identification and association for further processing or referencing.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin is a web page/component providing a UI for staff administrators to view, filter, and manage employment applications. The page includes date filters, site/discipline dropdowns, and a grid view of applications. It features validations for date entry and custom logic for retrieving and displaying applications.
purpose: To enable staff administrators to filter and manage submitted employment applications by site, discipline, and date range.

workflows.name: Filter and View Employment Applications
steps: Staff Admin loads the page.
Selects site and discipline (with 'All' options possible).
Enters date range (start and end).
Optionally chooses to include withdrawn applications.
Presses the refresh button.
Grid updates with filtered employment applications.

business_rules: StartDate is required and must be valid date.
EndDate is required and must be valid date.
Withdrawn applications can be toggled for visibility.
system_behavior: Page loads dropdowns and default dates.
Handles data binding, row display logic, and email/status formatting.
exceptions: If UserSession is null, data selection is canceled.

summary: ServiceCode is a model representing codes for various services, including fields for categorization, naming, sorting, and notes. It supports localization (alt-language fields) and is used for operations such as listing codes by course or timetable.
purpose: To represent, retrieve, and list service codes and their descriptions for categorization and business logic.

workflows.name: List Service Codes
steps: System calls ServiceCodeListAll procedure.
Codes are retrieved from DB and localized if alt language is active.
Codes are returned as a list with relevant properties.

workflows.name: List Service Codes by Course or Timetable
steps: System calls ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID or ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID.
Codes are filtered and retrieved.
List is returned.

business_rules: Use alt language fields based on session settings
system_behavior: Retrieval of codes from DB with localization logic

summary: SiteProfileHistory tracks changes/history to site profiles. It records action date, screen section, action, fields changed, agency/user info, and supports alt-language fields. Used for auditing and displaying history to users, including formatting for display/tooltips.
purpose: To maintain and display an audit trail/history of changes made to site profiles.

workflows.name: Search Site Profile History
steps: UserControl triggers SiteProfileHistorySearch.
Database procedure runs for SiteID and AgencyID.
List of history entries fetched, fields localized as needed.
History displayed in UI grid, with formatted names and tooltips.

business_rules: Use alt fields if session setting is enabled.
system_behavior: Fills dropdowns and tooltips for display.
Prevents action if UserSession is missing.
exceptions: If UserSession is null, selection is canceled.

summary: EmailPopupDocument is a class representing a file attached to an email popup, with fields for ID, filename, filepath, and checked state. Includes search and delete functions for managing these documents.
purpose: To represent and manage files/documents in email popups, including listing and deletion.

workflows.name: Search for Email Popup Documents
steps: System splits DataInfo string to build a list of EmailPopupDocument objects.

workflows.name: Delete Email Popup Document
steps: System performs file and directory deletion for the given ID.

business_rules: Documents must have a valid file name and path.
Deletion includes both file and directory cleanup.
system_behavior: Handles search and deletion of popup documents using string parsing and file operations.
exceptions: File/Directory deletion errors are caught and ignored.

summary: ExpenseBatch is a class representing expense batch processing, including batch identifiers, dates, descriptions, department, status, and closed date. It supports listing, search, add, update, and delete operations, with logic for batch formatting and status localization.
purpose: To manage and track batches of expenses for departments, including CRUD operations and status formatting.

workflows.name: CRUD Expense Batch
steps: Add: System creates batch via database procedure.
Search: System retrieves batches for department.
Update: System updates batch fields/status.
Delete: System deletes batch.

business_rules: BatchNumberFormatted combines ID and status description.
system_behavior: Batch operations are performed via DB procedures.
dependencies: ExpenseBatchAdd, ExpenseBatchSearch, ExpenseBatchUpdate, ExpenseBatchDelete DB procedures
